title: Jacksonville healthcare jobs: psychologist, dietitian, RN, LPN and pharmacist openings
text:
21 hours ago Jacksonville listings here span pediatric diagnostic psychology, acute-care nutrition leadership, senior living nursing, home health LPN work, and retail pharmacy. Great Strides Rehabilitation is seeking a licensed psychologist for autism and developmental evaluations, while Compass Group’s TouchPoint at St. Vincent’s Southside Hospital is hiring a lead dietitian to oversee a three-dietitian team in acute care. Life Care Services’ Cypress Village offers an RN role in senior living and skilled nursing, CenterWell Home Health needs an LPN for in-home care under RN direction, and CVS Health has a part-time staff pharmacist opening in retail pharmacy.
